topics.title: Read Postgres Query p95 in Splunk With One OTel Java Agent Setting
topics.signal: A Java agent 2.25 user with HikariCP asked why db.client.operation.duration did not appear, and a maintainer answered with the opt-in setting and where it must be set.

topics.title: Follow Every SQS Message Through Splunk APM With Zero Code
topics.signal: A Spring Boot SQS tracing thread in the OTel Java instrumentation repo, with 5 comments and 15 replies since July 2025, and a new reader asking in June 2026 whether producer and consumer share a trace by default.
